notes.zh-CN: Antigravity（Gemini）改为原生轨迹文件事件监听（macOS kqueue / Windows FindFirstChangeNotificationW）与迟到工具终态即时同步，彻底移除 2s/10s 空闲轮询与 45s 盲等续跑，后台工具结束后如未自唤醒则在短延迟后自动继续问答；同时包含 macOS 电脑操控首版、内置浏览器文件下载与图片预览滚轮缩放。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Replaced Antigravity (Gemini) periodic session/load polling and the blind 45 s resume timer with native OS transcript file watching (macOS kqueue / Windows FindFirstChangeNotificationW) plus immediate handling for late ACP tool_call_update completions, automatically continuing after a brief grace window only when a finished background tool does not self-wake. Also includes macOS Computer Use v1, built-in browser downloads, and scroll-wheel image zoom. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
